name: Tooth of the Narwhal
body:
Aura moderate evocation; CL 11th; Slot —; Price 55,800 gp; Weight 3 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This +3 rapier, when used on the open sea or within 100 feet of the coast, grants its wielder the use of the Combat Expertise feat and deals +1d6 points of bonus damage.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells divine power or caster must be druid level 7th+; Cost 27,900 gp.
